meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对指定主题做深度调研,产出带引用、经质检的结论报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要对某个主题做彻底调研,并需要可追溯的引用
copy.tagline_en: Run deep research on a topic and get a cited, vetted report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need exhaustive research on a topic with traceable citations

howto.what: 当你明确要求研究或深度调查时,Claude 会先自己划定题目范围,组建一个协作团队分头搜集线索,用辩论互相质疑结论,对有争议的说法跑代码验证,最后交付每条论断都带引用或验证证据的成果,默认 PDF + DOCX。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求研究或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”“ultradebate” 等研究措辞时触发;普通提问、调试或别的模式收集上下文都不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我彻查这个题目,先问我想要的交付格式。
say.note: 它会先给出格式与模板提议,等你确认再开工。

say.text: 对这个结论开一轮 ultradebate,攻击方和辩护方都要给证据。
say.note: 辩论过程和裁定会记入 claim graph。

say.text: 先把研究题目拆成几条互不重叠的轴线,再组队。
say.note: 它会先单独划范围并写出 brief.md。

howto.what_en: On an explicit research or deep-investigation request, Claude scopes the topic, stands up a team to fan out over sources, debates its own findings, proves contested claims with code, and delivers a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, or uses “ulw-research”, “ultradebate” and similar research wording. Ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic; ask me the output format first.
say_en.note: You get a format and template proposal before work starts.

say_en.text: Now run an ultradebate round on that conclusion, both sides with evidence.
say_en.note: Arguments and verdicts go into the claim graph.

say_en.text: Break the research question into orthogonal axes before standing up the team.
say_en.note: It writes the brief and axes first.
